policy_evidence.GLU_J:CONVERSION: The official GLU_J processing notes specify multiplication by 0.05551 and rounding to three decimals.
policy_evidence.WEIGHTING:SELECTION: Use the appropriate documented analysis weight and the masked stratum and PSU fields; component applicability is required.
policy_evidence.CORPUS:MANIFEST: Absence from the preserved 2017-2018 corpus supports only a release-scoped abstention.
policy_evidence.POLICY:JOINT_WEIGHT: This suite declines to infer a unique joint fasting/dietary weight without a declared joint selection or nonresponse adjustment. This is an author-defined conservative policy.
policy_evidence.POLICY:DEPENDENCY: Any feature transitively depending on a declared label source is excluded under the suite policy. Cycles in dependency graphs are rejected. This is an author-defined policy, not a CDC rule.
policy_evidence.POLICY:EXECUTION: Synthetic fixtures use a validated one-to-one left join, age >= minimum_age, finite nonmissing values and positive finite weights. Duplicate keys and negative weights are rejected. The weighted mean is sum(w*x)/sum(w).
